title: ORE Market Assumptions Module
description: Market rent, growth, and rollover assumptions. These travel with the file so any conforming engine reproduces identical lease-up and rollover cash flows.

asOfDate.description: Date the market assumptions were struck. Defaults to rentRoll.asOfDate.

growth.description: Annual growth assumptions. Growth compounds annually on each anniversary of the analysis start.

expenses.description: Operating expense growth (items may carry their own override).

cpi.description: CPI assumption used by leases with cpi escalations. Required if any lease escalates on CPI.

generalVacancyPercent.description: General vacancy allowance as a percent of potential gross revenue, applied in addition to explicit downtime. Engines must not double-count: months absorbed by explicit downtime are excluded from the general vacancy base.

creditLossPercent.description: Credit loss allowance as a percent of scheduled revenue.

marketLeasing.description: Market leasing profiles keyed by space type. Keys are matched by rentRoll.vacantSuites[].spaceType and by leases at rollover (via leaseSpaceType or the file's single profile).

growthCurve.description: Either a flat annual rate in percent (e.g. 3.0), or a stepped curve: entries apply from analysis year fromYear (1-based) until the next entry. The first entry must have fromYear 1.

leasingProfile.description: Assumptions for a new market lease of this space type, used for vacant-suite lease-up and lease rollover. At each lease expiration, engines blend renewal and new-tenant outcomes by renewalProbabilityPercent.

amount.description: Market rent as of marketAssumptions.asOfDate, grown by growth.marketRent thereafter.

unit.description: Unit for amount. Declared explicitly — never inferred from market convention.

escalation.description: Escalation pattern for market leases. Defaults to none.

reimbursementStructure.description: Reimbursement structure for market leases. MG market leases use the first calendar year of the new lease as the base year.

downtimeMonths.description: Vacant months before a new-tenant lease commences (after expiration, or from analysis start for vacant suites). Not applied to renewals.

renewalProbabilityPercent.description: Probability an expiring tenant renews. 100 disables new-tenant outcomes; 0 disables renewals.

newTenant.description: Leasing costs for the new-tenant outcome. Omitted fields default to 0.

renewal.description: Leasing costs for the renewal outcome. Omitted fields default to 0. Renewal rent is market rent unless renewalRentPercentOfMarket is set.

renewalRentPercentOfMarket.description: Renewal rent as a percent of market rent, e.g. 95.

tiPerSF.description: Tenant improvement allowance, USD per SF.

lcPercentOfRent.description: Leasing commission as a percent of total scheduled base rent over the lease term.

freeRentMonths.description: Months of full base rent abatement at lease start.
